name: Branding & corporate identity
h1: Branding and corporate design: a brand for every format.
lead: We develop logos and brand systems that hold up from letterhead to facade. Over {{stat.identities}} projects, documented so you can follow them.

facts.who: SMEs and agencies launching a new identity or putting their brand in order

problem: Many SMEs have a logo but no system. Every new print item and post looks different. That costs time and weakens recognition.
included: Positioning and brand workshop by video

process.d: The chosen direction in two feedback rounds.

faq.q: How many correction rounds are included?
faq.a: Two rounds in the fixed price. Further rounds are agreed transparently and charged by effort.

faq.q: Can you just rework our existing logo?
faq.a: Yes. In the intro call we check whether a rework is enough.
We do an initial search. For a legal trademark check, we recommend the IPI (Swiss Federal Institute of Intellectual Property) or a specialist.
